channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nepal's reluctance to accept foreign aid for flood relief draws criticism
item.description: Private sector power producers say Nepali authorities delayed rescuing hundreds trapped in hydropower facilities.

item.title: U.S. and Venezuela reach oil deal; NPR reveals hidden toll of U.S. heat deaths
item.description: The U.S. and Venezuela agreed on an oil deal. NPR's investigation found that heat-related deaths in the U.S. are higher than reported.

item.title: Paperwork, wait times, and hold music: The 'Time Tax' burdening Americans in need
item.description: Annie Lowrey examines the administrative hurdles in applying for government benefits, noting the cost goes beyond wasted time.

item.title: Lionel Messi announces retirement from international football with Argentina
item.description: Messi said he wrote his retirement letter after the World Cup final in July but delayed publishing it due to his father's health issues.
